text:
morgan-recruiter: Quick heads-up  candidate Juniper (senior infra) gave a verbal accept but needs a comp-band exception + structured sign-on for cross-border tax reasons. Proposed cash: total 275k (base 165k / bonus tgt 50k / sign-on 60k). Asking uplift to band E5 and sign-on split: 30% at start (escrowed), 40% at 3mo, 30% at 12mo. Start date target 2026-09-01, can move by 2 weeks.

nina-peopleops: Please upload the offer packet and a short tax/relocation note. Also confirm manager sign-off and whether escrow is acceptable.

ada-hm: Manager sign-off here. We prefer escrow for the first tranche to reduce cross-border bank timing issues. Candidate has one other offer, wants confirmation in 72h.

morgan-recruiter: Uploaded: gdrive.com/juniper-offer and gdrive.com/juniper-tax-brief. Included competing offer details in DM. Escrow vendor TBD; team prefers internal escrow via payroll if possible.

luca-legal: Flag  escrow + multi-country payments can create reporting obligations. Need tax counsel note and escrow agreement clause. If escrow is held outside company, we need beneficiary language and hold-harmless.

sandeep-finance: Finance needs FY1 cash schedule, GL ENG-PLAT-04, and confirmation whether escrow funds hit our balance sheet. If we hold escrow, we need a liability account and forecast impact. Also confirm currency for initial tranche.

morgan-recruiter: First-year cash estimate: pro-rated base (~$100k for Sep-Dec) + sign-on tranches: $18k (escrowed) + $24k at 3mo + $18k at 12mo. Currency: USD. We're not proposing gross-up except contingency for material dual-withholding.

approvals-bot: Approval created: https://rbwd/approvals/REQ-2026-0902-05. Approvers: nina-peopleops, comp-committee (chair: joel-comp), sandeep-finance, luca-legal. Status: Pending.

joel-comp: I'll review the packet today. Please add 3 market comps and internal parity snapshot. If committee approves uplift, we'll require a clear budget source and note whether uplift consumes special comp pool.

nina-peopleops: Added "time-sensitive  72h candidate hold" flag. I'm attaching market comps and the relocation note to the request now.

luca-legal: Also need proposed escrow agreement language and candidate consent for deferred payments. If escrow is on our books, legal + finance need to approve the terms before offer.

sandeep-finance: We can hold escrow on-balance-sheet but need GL mapping and expected release triggers. If escrow is off-ledger, we need vendor contract and evidence of funds flow. Finance wants final numbers by EOD tomorrow for forecasting.

morgan-recruiter: I'll update the approval packet with escrow language draft and the market comps link `gdrive.com/juniper-comps`. Marked expedite.

ada-hm: Candidate willing to accept escrow terms if we can confirm the band uplift and release schedule. Please prioritize.

joel-comp: I'll call an emergency comp-committee if we need a faster decision. Ping me once the packet includes market comps + budget line.

nina-peopleops: Noted. We'll aim for committee review + legal/finance sign-off within 48-72 hours. I'll post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
